theorem: Per-variable degree <= 4 in (J, Delta, K) and degree 4 in lambda, agreeing on Cartesian grid {-2, -1, 0, 1, 2}^3 (125 points) certifies exact polynomial identity det(lambda*I - H(J,Delta,K)) in Q[lambda, J, Delta, K].

carrier.domain: Rational field Q with exact rational arithmetic (fractions.Fraction)

limitations.evaluation_role: Host-derived intermediate prompt context ONLY; not a full QM solution, not evidence of solver accuracy.

failure_states.UNREGISTERED_SEED: The supplied seed SHA-256 does not match the supported benchmark seed.
failure_states.SEED_HASH_MISMATCH: The seed SHA-256 in artifact headers contradicts the request seed.
failure_states.PUBLIC_INPUT_MISMATCH: The Hamiltonian coefficient matrices do not match the admitted public artifact.
failure_states.MATRIX_SHAPE_MISMATCH: The Hamiltonian matrices are not 4x4 or have invalid affine parameter count.
failure_states.MALFORMED_RATIONAL: Rational coefficients fail the canonical wire format, range, or bit limits.
failure_states.DUPLICATE_POWERS: Sparse monomial representation contains duplicate exponent vectors before zero removal.
failure_states.NONMONIC_LEADING_COEFFICIENT: The degree-4 characteristic polynomial leading coefficient is not 1.
failure_states.DEGREE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Polynomial exceeds degree 4 in lambda or per-variable degree 4 in (J, Delta, K).
failure_states.GRID_ALIASING_DETECTED: Polynomial degree aliasing or divergence outside the 125-point Cartesian grid.
failure_states.STALE_SOURCE_HASH: Pinned source dependencies have been modified or tampered with.
failure_states.SWAPPED_BINARY: Native sidecar binary hash does not match the verified build custody receipt.
failure_states.CONTRADICTION_FINAL_ANSWER_CLAIM: Artifact improperly claims to certify full QM solution or eigenvectors.
failure_states.PROMPT_INJECTION_DETECTED: Untrusted prompt injection pattern detected in artifact metadata or context.
failure_states.NONCOMMUTING_SUBSTITUTION: Parameters were substituted in non-standard order or non-commuting form.
failure_states.FORGED_CERTIFICATE: Artifact claims certification without authentic native sidecar verification.
